description: This file contains shell-script-based tests for git rebase operations involving merge commits and workflow scenarios, including setup functions, test cases for linear and non-linear history rebase, and detailed steps for verifying rebase outcomes.

methods.name: test_revision_subjects
methods.description: Verifies that the commit subjects match expected values for given revisions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_run_rebase
methods.description: Performs a rebase operation with specified parameters and checks the outcome.
